has_nest: The blue box extends from the upper center to the right side of the image. The main body of the nest is near the center of the upper beam, directly above the insulator string, with many branches extending downward below the beam.
has_insulator: Yes | At least one insulator string and its connecting fittings are visible in the image.
nest_type: Yes | The nest is located on an outward-extending crossarm, clearly away from the vertical tower body and directly above the insulator string.
material_droop: Yes | A large amount of branches, straw, or other nest material visibly hangs down from the crossarm toward the insulator string.
nest_stable: No | Drooping material is present, so the decision proceeds to Step 4B and the Step 4A nest-structure check is not applicable.
material_touch: Yes | The drooping material clearly exceeds the length of the connecting fittings and reaches, contacts, or wraps around the upper part of the insulator string.
grade_result: Urgent | An insulator string is visible, and the nest is located on a crossarm away from the vertical tower body. A large amount of nest material hangs beyond the connecting fittings and reaches or contacts the insulator area. According to Step 4B, the defect is graded as Urgent.
